```{r load seurat object}

sall1_mg <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/SALL1_overexpression/sall1_mg_exp1_integrated.rds")

sall1_levels <- factor(c("CTRL", "SALL1_rep1", "SALL1_rep2"))
sall1_mg$orig.ident <- factor(sall1_mg$orig.ident, levels = sall1_levels)
Idents(sall1_mg) <- "orig.ident"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
sall1_col <-setNames(c(c("#E69000","#58B6AC", "#026D7D")), sall1_levels)

```


```{r find cluster markers of all cells}

Idents(sall1_mg) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

table(sall1_mg$orig.ident, sall1_mg$RNA_snn_res.0.3)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(sall1_mg, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/SALL1_overexpression/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/SALL1_overexpression/top50_cl_markers.csv")

```

#### Plot cluster markers.
```{r heatmap top markers by cell type, fig.height=7, fig.width=4}

DefaultAssay(sall1_mg) <- "RNA"
Idents(sall1_mg) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

library(gplots)
avg_cond_cl <- sapply(levels(sall1_mg$RNA_snn_res.0.3), function(x) rowMeans(sall1_mg@assays$RNA@data[,which(sall1_mg$RNA_snn_res.0.3==x)]))
# scale the data as 0 to 1 (instead)
# for top 2 markers
top_cl_markers_unique <- top5_cl_markers[!duplicated(top5_cl_markers[ , "gene"]), ]  # Delete rows
top2_cl_markers_unique <- top_cl_markers_unique %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
mat_norm <- apply(avg_cond_cl[top2_cl_markers_unique$gene,], 1, function(x) (x-min(x,na.rm=T))/(max(x,na.rm=T)-min(x,na.rm=T)))
col.order <- top2_cl_markers_unique$gene
mat_norm <- mat_norm[,col.order]
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/heatmap_scaled_top2_markers_RNA_snn_res.0.3.pdf", width = 5, height = 14)
heatmap.2(t(mat_norm), Colv=NA, Rowv = NA, trace="none", scale="none", margins=c(7,9), cexRow=1, cexCol=1, col =  colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(91), key=T, keysize = 2, density.info = "none") 
dev.off()

# for top 10 markers
mat_norm <- apply(avg_cond_cl[top10_cl_markers$gene,], 1, function(x) (x-min(x,na.rm=T))/(max(x,na.rm=T)-min(x,na.rm=T)))
col.order <- top10_cl_markers$gene
mat_norm <- mat_norm[,col.order]
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/heatmap_scaled_top10_markers_RNA_snn_res.0.3.pdf", width = 5, height = 14)
heatmap.2(t(mat_norm), Colv=NA, Rowv = NA, trace="none", scale="none", margins=c(7,9), cexRow=1, cexCol=1, col =  colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(91), key=T, keysize = 2, density.info = "none") 
dev.off()

# for top 50 markers
mat_norm <- apply(avg_cond_cl[top50_cl_markers$gene,], 1, function(x) (x-min(x,na.rm=T))/(max(x,na.rm=T)-min(x,na.rm=T)))
col.order <- top50_cl_markers$gene
mat_norm <- mat_norm[,col.order]
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/heatmap_scaled_top50_markers_RNA_snn_res.0.3.pdf", width = 5, height = 14)
heatmap.2(t(mat_norm), Colv=NA, Rowv = NA, trace="none", scale="none", margins=c(7,9), cexRow=1, cexCol=1, col =  colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(91), key=T, keysize = 2, density.info = "none") 
dev.off()
```

#### Plot cell number per sample
```{r cell number}

# create a dataset of all cells
cells_cl <- as.data.frame(table(sall1_mg$orig.ident))
cells_cl$Var1 <- factor(x = cells_cl$Var1, levels = sall1_levels)

colnames(cells_cl)[which(names(cells_cl) == "Var1")] <- "Sample"

# Stacked
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/no_cells_per_sample.pdf",  width = 12, height = 6)
ggplot(cells_cl, aes(fill=Sample, y=Freq, x=Sample)) +
    geom_bar( stat="identity") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    xlab("Cell type") +
    ylab("iMGL cell number") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sall1_col) +
   theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16))
dev.off()

```

#### Seurat-based label transfer
```{r Seurat-based label transfer all cells}

###### ALL CELLS ######

Idents(seurat_MG) <- "celltype"

# Perform Seurat label transfer for projection of the reference onto the query (iPSC-dervied) microglia
# Find anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = seurat_MG, query = sall1_mg, dims = 1:50, npcs = 50, reduction = "rpca", k.filter = NA,verbose = F)
# Transfer the categorical information across the two datasets as predict.id
# Seurat does not correct or modify the query expression data
# Label transfer based on timepoint
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = sall1_mg, refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$timepoint_wks), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca") # project the PCA structure of the reference onto the query by default (this can be changed with the weight.reduction parameter). TransferData returns a matrix with predicted IDs and prediction scores, which we can add to the query metadata.
sall1_mg$timepoint_wks_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id

# Label transfer based on cell type
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = sall1_mg, refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$celltype), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca")
sall1_mg$celltype_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id

# Order metadata levels
levels_primary_wks <- factor(c(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18))
sall1_mg$timepoint_wks_transfer <- factor(sall1_mg$timepoint_wks_transfer, levels = levels_primary_wks)

# Plot the label transfer by timepoint
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/transfer_kracht_by_week.pdf",  width = 6, height = 5)
DimPlot(sall1_mg, group.by="timepoint_wks_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols = vintage_rich_cols(11)) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
png("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/transfer_kracht_by_week.png",  width = 2700, height = 2600, res = 500)
DimPlot(sall1_mg, group.by="timepoint_wks_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols =  vintage_rich_cols(11)) & NoAxes()
dev.off()


# Plot the label transfer by cell type
```

```{r module score for all cells}
top50_ct_markers_kracht <- read.csv("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Plots/Kracht_primary_microglia/top50_ct_markers_kracht_renamed_ct.csv")

homeostatic_late <- top50_ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  filter(cluster == "Homeostatic microglia (late)") %>% filter(gene != c("RNA5SP151"))
homeostatic_early <- top50_ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  filter(cluster == "Homeostatic microglia (early)") %>% filter(gene != c("RPL17P50")) %>% filter(gene != c("PRXL2C"))

sall1_mg <- AddModuleScore(object = sall1_mg, features = homeostatic_early$gene, ctrl = 50, name = 'homeostatic_early')
```

```{r pathway activity inference in TS_BBB endothelial cells }

library(decoupleR)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(rcartocolor)
library(dplyr)


net <- get_progeny(organism = 'human', top = 100)
net

# Extract the normalized log-transformed counts
mat_sall1_mg <- as.matrix(sall1_mg@assays$RNA@data)

# Run wmean
acts <- run_wmean(mat=mat_sall1_mg, net=net, .source='source', .target='target',
                  .mor='weight', times = 100, minsize = 5)
acts

# Extract norm_wmean and store it in pathwayswmean in data
sall1_mg[['pathwayswmean']] <- acts %>%
  filter(statistic == 'norm_wmean') %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', names_from = 'condition',
              values_from = 'score') %>%
  column_to_rownames('source') %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
DefaultAssay(object = sall1_mg) <- "pathwayswmean"
Idents(sall1_mg) <- "orig.ident"

# Scale the data
sall1_mg <- ScaleData(sall1_mg)
sall1_mg@assays$pathwayswmean@data <- sall1_mg@assays$pathwayswmean@scale.data

p1 <- DimPlot(sall1_mg, reduction = "umap_css", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  NoLegend() + ggtitle('Cell types')
p2 <- (FeaturePlot(sall1_mg, features = c("Trail")) & 
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = 'blue', mid = 'white', high = 'red')) +
  ggtitle('Trail activity')
p1 | p2

# Extract activities from object as a long dataframe
df <- t(as.matrix(sall1_mg@assays$pathwayswmean@data)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cluster = Idents(sall1_mg)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(cluster, source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(score))

# Transform to wide matrix
top_acts_mat <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'cluster', names_from = 'source',
              values_from = 'mean') %>%
  column_to_rownames('cluster') %>%
  as.matrix()
top_acts_mat <- top_acts_mat[,-1]
top_acts_mat <- top_acts_mat[,-2]

# Choose color palette
palette_length = 100
my_color = colorRampPalette(c("#710085", "#E0E2DD","#006b02"))(palette_length)

my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0, length.out=ceiling(palette_length/2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out=floor(palette_length/2)))

# Plot
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/pathway_progeny.pdf")
pheatmap(top_acts_mat, border_color = NA, color=my_color, breaks = my_breaks, cluster_rows = T, cluster_cols = T, scale = "column")
dev.off()

```
